mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_group ( id, name, avatar_url, creator_id, character_id, description, max_members, is_public, join_requires_approval, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{avatarUrl}, #{creatorId}, #{characterId}, #{description}, #{maxMembers}, #{isPublic}, #{joinRequiresApproval}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_group WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM chat_group WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT g.id AS group_id, g.name, g.avatar_url, g.description, g.max_members, g.join_requires_approval, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS member_count, CASE WHEN mine.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS is_member, jr.status AS join_request_status FROM chat_group g LEFT JOIN chat_group_member m ON m.group_id = g.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN chat_group_member mine ON mine.group_id = g.id AND mine.user_id = #{userId} AND mine.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN chat_group_join_request jr ON jr.group_id = g.id AND jr.user_id = #{userId} AND jr.status = 'PENDING' AND jr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.is_public = 1
AND ( g.name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.description LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(g.id AS TEXT) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.avatar_url, g.description, g.max_members, g.join_requires_approval, mine.id, jr.status ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
